tasks.build: deno task check && deno run -A npm:vite@8.3.4 build
tasks.check: deno task check:generated && deno task check:content && deno task check:locales && deno run -A npm:svelte-check@4.7.7 --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
tasks.test: deno test -A --no-check --parallel tests/contracts.test.mjs tests/content.test.ts tests/content-recipes.test.ts tests/train-fixtures.test.ts tests/train-renderer.test.ts tests/fleet-state.test.ts tests/stock-catalog.test.ts tests/optional-content.test.ts tests/shell-model.test.ts tests/remote-client.test.ts tests/map.test.ts tests/spatial.test.ts tests/audio.test.ts tests/save-transfer.test.ts tests/ui-preferences.test.ts tests/localization.test.ts tests/terrain.test.ts tests/terrain-painter.test.ts tests/terrain-renderer.test.ts tests/railway-renderer.test.ts tests/railway-edit.test.ts tests/object-removal.test.ts tests/state-transfer.test.ts tests/mixed-state.test.ts tests/world-preview.test.ts
tasks.test:browser: deno task build && deno task test:browser:run
tasks.profile: deno task build && deno run -A npm:vite@8.3.4 build --config vite.profile.config.ts && deno run -A scripts/profile-web.ts
tasks.test:browser:extended: deno task build && deno task test:browser:run --config playwright.extended.config.ts
tasks.test:browser:performance: deno task build && deno task test:browser:run --config playwright.performance.config.ts
tasks.test:browser:continuation: deno task build && deno run -A scripts/test-mixed-continuation.ts
tasks.test:browser:all: deno task test:browser:extended && deno run -A scripts/test-mixed-continuation.ts
